  • Meals with customizable proteins

Fresh and Easy Meal Plans

Fresh and Easy’s chef-prepared meals make getting dinner on the table a snap. To cater to busy families Fresh and Easy offers meal plans for two, four, or six people. There are five Meal options to choose from when building your box.

Fast & Fresh meals

The Fast & Fresh meals are ready to go when they arrive. Just heat them in the microwave or oven and dinner is served.

Oven-Ready

Oven-Ready meals arrive in an oven-safe aluminum tray, ready for you to pop them straight in the oven with minimal preparation required.

Grill-Ready

Fresh and Easy also offers meals that are ideal for grilling. Their grill-ready meals require simple assembly of the ingredients in a grill-safe bag. Just throw it on the grill for a quick, flavorful meal.

15 Minute Meal Kits

For those who prefer to do a little bit of work themselves, the 15 Minute Meal Kits are slightly more hands-on, but still, make dinner easy to get on the table in a short period of time.

Entrée Salad

This is a nice option from Fresh and Easy for those days you want to eat something light. You get fresh vegetables that are pre-portioned (and pre-cooked if they include roasted veggies) - just toss everything together and you’re good to go.

Fresh and Easy Dietary Options and Programs

Unlike other meal delivery services, Fresh and Easy doesn’t offer dietary plans that fit a variety of eating patterns, but you can customize their existing plans to suit your needs.

There are two dietary options to choose from, Calorie-Conscious and Carb-Conscious.

Calorie-Conscious meals are designed to support weight loss.

Carb-Conscious meals are made to help with weight loss and/or blood sugar management.

You can also exclude common allergens from your menu, such as fish, shellfish, peanuts, and tree nuts. Dairy-free and gluten-free meals can be chosen as well.

The Calorie-Conscious or Carb-Conscious options can be made vegetarian by choosing “no beef, no pork, no poultry, no fish, no shellfish”. A dairy-free meal option is not available, though dairy could be avoided depending on your meal choice.

Our Favorite Fresh and Easy Meals

A great selection from the Calorie-Conscious menu is the Honey Cashew Shrimp, a delicious and calorie smart shrimp dish, served with savory broccoli fried rice.

The Carb-Conscious menu also has some tasty dishes to offer, including a Peruvian-inspired steak, a Basil-Parmesan crusted salmon, and a sherry glazed roasted chicken.

How Fresh and Easy Works

How to Get Started With Fresh and Easy

The first thing you need to do is press the Get Started button on the Fresh and Easy website. You’ll then choose between the Calorie-Conscious or Carb-Conscious options, and flag the foods you’d like to avoid.

Next, you’ll be asked to sign up, after which you’ll be asked a few questions such as how many people you’re cooking for, and how many recipes you’d like to receive each week. Next, you’ll provide your shipping information and enter the date you’d like to schedule your first delivery.

After the delivery date is confirmed, you’ll need to enter your payment information. Once you’re done with all that, you can make your meal selections for the first delivery.

How to Choose Meals with Fresh and Easy

Within the dietary option you’ve selected (Calorie-Conscious and Carb-Conscious), there will be five options to choose from: Fast & Fresh, Oven-Ready, Grill-Ready, 15 Minute Meal Kits, and Entrée Salads.

These customizable meal plans allow you to choose which foods to avoid. You can also tailor your meals to your dietary needs by selecting vegetarian or dairy-free options.

Does Fresh and Easy Come With Cooking Instructions?

Recipe cards are provided with each order and are easy to follow step-by-step instructions and images. In addition, if you lose or misplace your cards, images of meal components and the finished product are provided on the Fresh and Easy website.

Nutritional information is also provided per serving of each meal, so you can always keep tabs on the nutritious value of what you’re eating.

Additional ingredients like cooking oil, salt, and pepper may be required. Recipes may be modified at home with the addition or deletion of ingredients.

What Makes Fresh and Easy Stand Out?

Fresh and Easy uses fresh, seasonal ingredients are used in every meal and may vary by location. They also offer a variety of heat and eat options that can be popped in the microwave, making it very quick to get dinner on the table.

Fresh and Easy also offers a collection of high-end meals. These are offered at a higher price and can be used for occasions (or just a fancy Tuesday night) and contain a selection of premium ingredients. For example, high-end protein options such as Ahi tuna, salmon, and shrimp are offered regularly.

As part of the Home Chef collection, Fresh and Easy meals may be available at the Kroger family stores including Fred Meyer, Harris Teeter, King, and Smith’s.

Home Chef supports Doctors, Nurses, Hospital Employees, First Responders, and Teachers. Verify with ID.me at checkout to receive an exclusive discount.

How Are Fresh and Easy Meals Packaged and Shipped?

Fresh and Easy meals are delivered in a recyclable box on your chosen day of delivery. The delivery day options are usually Monday through Friday but will depend on where you live. The boxes are designed to keep the food refrigerated for up to 8 hours, but it is always best to put it in the fridge right away.

Since the meals are designed to be easy to prepare, they arrive in individual bags organized by recipe. Oven or grill-ready meals arrive in individual containers that can be used to cook in.

The protein is packaged at the bottom of the box to prevent cross-contamination with other ingredients. Protein is also packaged with additional ice packs to keep it at the right temperature.

Much of the packaging and liners are made of biodegradable material or can be recycled after use.

How to Contact Fresh and Easy Customer Service

  • Methods of contact 872-225-2433 or 855-949-3049 Toll-Free, via web site: Submit a request – Home Chef
  • A chat “bot” is available on the site for basic FAQs.
  • Getting refunds: For help regarding in-store purchases, contact Kroger Customer Care at 1-800-632-6900
  • Supporting documentation and additional reading can be found here.
  • Hours of operation Monday-Friday, 9 am-6 pm CST, Saturdays 10 am-2 pm CST, Sunday Closed

How to Pause or Cancel Your Fresh and Easy Account

You can cancel or pause Fresh and Easy at any time by clicking Account in the upper right corner of your dashboard. Go to Account Settings, then Pause Subscription at the bottom of the options on the left. There is no cancellation fee.

Is There a Fresh and Easy App?

Fresh and easy has an app that’s easy to use and includes all the features available on their regular website including meal selection, shipping, and payment processing. In the app, you can modify your meals and look ahead for what meals will be offered in the future.

What’s Unique About Trifecta?

Trifecta is the diet plan for serious athletes who want to get ripped or maintain their impressive physique. But it’s also a great option for people who just want to eat healthier, cleaner diets and don’t know how to go about doing that. Because Trifecta’s diet consists of ready-made meals, it’s literally the easiest way to get healthy food into your body, inside your schedule. Here are a few reasons we love Trifecta:

  • Quality

Trifecta doesn’t just deliver fresh meals, it delivers TOP quality fresh meals. And we mean the works. We’re talking whole grains, lean proteins, sustainable meats, grass-fed beef and bison, free-range chickens, wild caught seafood, organic fruits and vegetables, non-GMO ingredients, no additives, you name it! What’s more, meals are made on the spot, prepared by professional chefs. In fact, Trifecta might have the most premium quality meals on the market.

  • Ready-made

One of the biggest reasons people fall off the healthy lifestyle wagon is time. Between work, life, and relationships, there just isn’t enough time to also prepare healthy meals, and, sadly, that’s one of the first things to go when life gets too hectic. Trifecta takes care of this problem by delivering ready-made meals to your door. You can skip the menu planning, shopping, and any prep work, cutting serious hours out of your busy week. Fresh meals delivered weekly ensure that you can stay on target and get the nutrients you need without all the hassle and time it usually takes.

  • Science-based nutrition

Anyone can starve themselves, but Trifecta has spent a long time figuring out exactly what your body needs to thrive. All meals are perfectly-balanced so you know you are getting precisely the right amount of nutrients and filling your macronutrient goals. Plus, each meal comes with a clear breakdown of its macronutrients, so you really have a clear picture of what’s going into your body. And the proof is in the pudding. Just check out Trifecta’s results.

Dieters Are Raving

Trifecta is a popular choice for some major athletes like CrossFit champions, UFC champions, and bodybuilding champions, including big names like Brooke Ence, Cody Garbrandt, Mike Rashid, and Taylor Dayne Loyd. Here’s a quote from some Trifecta pros who use this diet to fuel their intense lifestyle.

After eating Trifecta meals for months it was clear why they were the largest all-organic meal delivery company in the nation. Their food is the greatest, and I am thrilled to now be an investor and partner in the company. Nutrition is the foundation of fitness, so we are bringing you guys the highest quality food on the planet, directly to your doors, nationwide.” - Bradley Martyn

“I really like how tasty it is, how fast and convenient it is. It just makes sense because your time is worth a lot, especially with what we do. I love it.” - Rose Namajunas

“Trifecta saves you time so you can crush your goals without wasting a single minute.” - Brooke Ence

“MMA is a tough and demanding sport and Trifecta has been a massive support to the guys on my team. You are looking for every advantage as an athlete. Trifecta makes things so much easier.” - Urijah Faber

While geared to help people bulk up and trim down, Trifecta isn’t just for athletes. Here are a few of the many average Joes who’ve achieved success using Trifecta:

“Following the macros and staying within the amount of protein and fat and carbs I need and to stay in my calorie deficit, it makes it where it's not short-term anymore. I can see myself doing this forever.” - Sara

“I don't have time with my career to actually cook. I do have time on the weekends but I never get around to it. I tried Freshly first and didn’t really like it too much. Then I found you guys. I saw Trifecta all over Facebook so I switched over and I really liked the food so I continued to order it. Having everything already premade for you, ready to go, everything's measured and weighed out, it's the right macros, I'm good to go with that.” - Drew

"I got my business partner onto Trifecta as well, and we put a microwave in our rig so that we can heat up Trifecta for lunch. With Trifecta and logging my food I have managed to lose weight, feel better, and sleep better, and be more lean.” - Kim

How it Works

Trifecta is an online delivery service. Here’s how that works:

  • Pick the plan you want (more on that below)
  • Pick the number of meals you want per day. You can order up to 4 per day
  • Choose if you want meals on 5 or 7 days a week
  • Choose if you want breakfast included
  • Add account details (shipping address, email, etc.)
  • Confirm payment details
  • Wait for your food to arrive!

Alternatively, you can order meals a la carte.

What You’ll Eat

Trifecta has top-quality meals, but we’ve already discussed that. What we haven’t mentioned is the variety Trifecta offers. You can get breakfasts, lunches, and dinners depending on the plan you are on, and with tons of meal options. There are 5 different choices for each of the 3 daily meals, and the menu changes up every week to steer clear of boredom. Meal plan options include:

  • Paleo
  • Keto
  • Clean
  • Vegan
  • Classic
  • Vegetarian
  • Gluten-free

All plans are dairy and soy-free. It’s also great that you can specify allergies or dietary-restrictions such as shellfish, mushrooms, and nuts. Each meal plan comes with a different menu. So what you eat will depend on both your own choices, and the type of meal plan you choose. Again, the focus is on getting a balanced meal regardless of which plan or which menu option you choose. Here’s a sample Trifecta menu based on the paleo meal plan:

Breakfast: Zucchini and Bell Pepper Frittata

Eggs served with zucchini and bell peppers

Lunch: Sesame Meatballs

Beef meatballs served with mixed squash and red cabbage

Dinner: Tangerine Chicken

Chicken breast in a citrus glaze served with asparagus and toasted almonds

Mobile App

The Trifecta mobile app is awesome. You can easily adjust your meal plans, add a la carte items, and change delivery preferences. But that’s just the tip of the iceberg. The Trifecta app also lets you track calories and macros, track workouts, use workout timers, get recipes, and access both the extensive workout library and the extremely supportive Trifecta community.

That’s the free version, but you can upgrade to premium if you want more benefits. For $10 a month or $4.16/month for an annual subscription, you’ll get premium features including movement library, macronutrient dashboard, workout logs, HD movement videos, exclusive content, monthly live video chat, members-only Facebook group, workout music player, analytics, and more. If you’re serious about your fitness, then the upgrade is a good idea.

Pricing

Pricing will vary depending on which plan you want, which meals you choose, how many meals per day and days per week you choose, and whether or not you include breakfast. The average Trifecta meal can range from $5.50 to $15. Here’s a look at some of the prices you could pay for a week’s worth of meals from Trifecta:

You can also order meals a la carte if you want to augment your plan or your daily diet. Trifecta has free delivery to the entire continental US.

Help & Support

Trifecta has a tremendous support system. There’s the customer support that is available via email, phone, and even live chat. And you can also find nearly any answer in the help center. Trifecta also has a blog with tons of useful information. But the best part of all is the Trifecta community. You’ll have access to real people who are living the life and really doing it using Trifecta’s diet. You can also speak to nutrition coaches for free. It’s an excellent resource that helps people stay on target even when things get rough.

Here’s the Skinny

Trifecta is a fabulous way to lose weight, get healthy, and eat clean. Using macronutrient-based meal plans, Trifecta delivers fresh and healthy meals that are ready-made and delicious to boot. You can get paleo, keto, vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and other meal options delivered to your door. And Trifecta also has a great mobile app with fitness training videos, meal tracking, and lots of other great tools to help you get the results you want.

Sunbasket at a Glance

What Is Sunbasket?

Sunbasket is a meal delivery service that delivers organic, chef-crafted meals directly to your doorstep. Its focus on sustainable, high-quality ingredients sourced from trusted farms provides the nutrients you need to support a healthy lifestyle. Similar to Home Chef, it offers both meal kits and ready-to-eat options. Whether your goal is saving time on grocery shopping, reducing processed foods, or meal prepping for weight loss, Sunbasket has you covered.

The menu features a variety of options, including Paleo, Vegetarian, Diabetes-Friendly, High Protein, and Low-Calorie dishes. But it doesn’t stop at dinner—you can also get lunch, breakfast, and snacks from its marketplace.

Sunbasket Meal Plans

Sunbasket offers ten diverse meal plans for singles, couples, and families of four. You can choose a minimum of four meals weekly, covering breakfast, lunch, and dinner options. Its Classic Meal Kits serve two or four people, while Fresh & Ready meals are portioned for one.

Developed by award-winning chefs and approved by dietitians, all meals emphasize nutrient-dense ingredients. They contain 400-800 calories per serving, at least 5g of fiber and 10g of protein, and typically less than 800mg of sodium. The service allows you to mix and match from its full menu, filtering options based on dietary preferences like Paleo, Vegetarian, or Diabetes-Friendly, as well as nutritional goals such as High Protein or Low Calorie.

Cooking times vary from ready-to-heat meals to 30-minute recipes. The dishes feature seasonal, often organic produce and whole grains. They also include high-quality proteins and good fats. Sunbasket minimizes the use of added sugar and processed ingredients in its meals.

Sunbasket Dietary Options and Programmes

Prepared Meals (Serve 1)

Fresh & Ready

Sunbasket's Fresh & Ready meals offer a convenient solution for busy days. These healthy, heat-and-eat options feature organic produce and require no prep or cleanup. Try the "Gyro-spiced chicken bowl with brown rice, lemon yogurt, and slaw" for a satisfying high-protein dish. Alternatively, the "Korean turkey japchae with glass noodles, kale, and mushrooms" caters to various dietary needs, including gluten-free, dairy-free, and paleo diets.

Meal Kits (Serve 2 or 4)

Chef’s Choice

Experience restaurant-quality meals at home with Sunbasket's Chef's Choice plan. The chefs handpick recipes that showcase peak seasonal organic produce, premium meats and seafood, and unique house-made sauces.

For example, you might enjoy "Orange glazed ribs with cucumber tiger salad and rice," a Northern Chinese-inspired dish that combines crisp vegetables and spicy jalapeños with a sweet, spicy, and nutty dressing. Served alongside orange-glazed spare ribs and jasmine rice, this meal always promises a flavor-packed dinner.

Paleo

A study comparing 11 popular diets found the Paleo Diet to be the most effective for reducing inflammation, improving blood lipid profiles, and controlling blood sugar. With Sunbasket's Paleo meal delivery, you'll enjoy dishes rich in meat and vegetables with fewer carbs.

These clean, high-protein recipes feature organic fresh produce and top-quality proteins while excluding dairy, gluten, grains, soy, and corn. For example, you might savor a "Spicy chipotle turkey and sweet potato chili with cabbage slaw," packing a flavorful punch at just 570 calories per serving.

Gluten-Free

If you're among the 6% of Americans with gluten intolerance, Sunbasket offers a variety of delicious gluten-free dinners. You can enjoy dishes like "Japanese shrimp Kamameshi rice with red pickled ginger" without feeling deprived. These meals feature fresh vegetables, high-quality meats, seafood, and the chef's preferred gluten-free alternatives.

Note: Sunbasket’s meals are prepared in a facility that handles wheat. Due to the risk of cross-contamination, you should be cautious if you have severe gluten intolerance or celiac disease.

Lean & Clean

Sunbasket's Lean & Clean plan offers protein-packed recipes to boost your gains while helping you manage your weight. These flavorful meals, averaging around 550 calories per serving, are high in protein and fiber but free from gluten and dairy. You'll enjoy dishes like the "Steak salad with strawberries and spiced chickpeas," which contains only 400 calories per serving.

Vegetarian

Sunbasket offers several meat alternatives if you’re on a vegetarian diet, like the "Summer vegetable skewers with baba ganoush, feta dip, and flatbread." If you're a pescatarian, you can enrich your diet with sustainably sourced seafood certified by the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC). A delicious example is the "Salmon and quinoa bowls with wilted greens and citrus dressing." Plus, it’s pre-prepped.

Mediterranean

Sunbasket offers delightful Mediterranean-inspired meals that embrace the hallmarks of this heart-healthy diet: seasonal produce, lean meats, whole grains, and good fats. These dishes, can help reduce inflammation and may ease symptoms of Rheumatoid Arthritis. Tempting options include "Mayan butter bean and quinoa bowls with avocado and oranges" and "Chicken and spaghetti with kale and caramelized onions."

Diabetes-Friendly

Sunbasket offers a rare find in meal delivery: diabetic-friendly meal kits. If you're managing diabetes, you'll appreciate how Sunbasket takes the guesswork out of meal planning. The service provides nutritious, carefully portioned meals like "Blackened sole with turmeric cauliflower and artichoke-spinach dip," containing just 430 calories per serving.

Carb-Conscious

Featuring dishes with 35g net carbs or fewer per serving, this plan helps you manage your carbohydrate intake without sacrificing flavor. Recent studies suggest that low-carb diets may offer a metabolic advantage, burning 200 to 300 more calories compared to high-carb diets of the same calorie content.

Explore global flavors while keeping carbs in check, like the "Marrakech lamb merguez patties with warm carrot salad" that brings North African cuisine to your table.

Preparing Your Meals

When your Sunbasket arrives, promptly refrigerate all ingredients. For optimal freshness, eat meals with seafood first, followed by Fresh & Ready meals, Pre-Prepped Meal Kits, and finally, Classic Meal Kits. Fresh & Ready meals can be heated in the microwave or oven, and some can even be frozen for later use. Meal Kits stay fresh in the fridge for up to a week, while Fresh & Ready meals are best consumed within three to five days.

For Meal Kits, you'll need basic pantry staples like cooking oil, salt, and pepper and standard kitchen equipment such as pots, pans, and utensils. These kits come with easy-to-follow recipes, typically ready in 30 minutes or less. Fresh & Ready meals require no preparation beyond heating. For the best results, follow the heating instructions provided with each meal.

How Sunbasket Works

When you sign up, you choose a meal plan that fits your dietary preferences, from Paleo to Vegetarian and everything in between. You can select Meal Kits to cook yourself or Fresh & Ready meals for quick heating, with at least four servings per week. The service allows you to mix and match options from their full menu, starting at $9.99 per serving, with free shipping on your first delivery.

In your Sunbasket, you'll find fresh organic produce, responsibly raised meats free of antibiotics and hormones, and sustainably sourced seafood, along with seasonings and sauces. You can view detailed information for each recipe or meal, including ingredients, potential allergens, nutritional content, and preparation instructions. Prices are listed per item, and you can see your order total before checkout.

Deliveries are made Sunday through Thursday to most US zip codes (excluding AK, HI, MT, ND, and parts of NM) in packaging designed to maintain freshness. While you're billed automatically each week, you can skip weeks, pause, or cancel your subscription anytime before the weekly cut-off on Wednesdays at 12 p.m. PT / 3 p.m. ET.

How to Get Started With Sunbasket

To begin your Sunbasket experience, follow these steps:

  1. Visit the Sunbasket website and create an account by providing your name, email, and zip code. This allows you to view meal prices and start your plan.
  2. Choose your preferred meal plan from Paleo, Vegetarian, Mediterranean, or Diabetes-Friendly options. You can also select "Chef's Choice" if you prefer a variety of options.
  3. Decide on the number of servings you want per week (minimum of four) and whether you prefer Meal Kits, Fresh & Ready meals, or a mix of both.
  4. Select your meals from Sunbasket's full menu, which changes weekly. You can filter options based on dietary preferences and cooking time.
  5. At checkout, choose your delivery frequency (weekly is standard, but you can adjust this later) and enter your shipping and payment details.
  6. Enter your address details and payment information.
  7. Review your order and confirm. Remember, your first delivery comes with free shipping.

Sunbasket Customer Service

Sunbasket offers multiple ways to get help with your order or answer your questions. You can chat with Sunny B., its digital assistant, available 24/7 for immediate support. If you prefer direct assistance, its customer service team is available Monday through Friday from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. PT and weekends from 6 a.m. to 1 p.m. PT (excluding some holidays).

You can reach them by phone at (866) SUN-BSKT (866-786-2758), text at +1 208-960-6505, or email using the contact form on the help page. Sunbasket responds to emails within 24 hours.

For quick answers, check out the companies’ comprehensive FAQ page, recipes section, and blog, which offer information on meal plans, delivery, cooking tips, and customer stories.

How to Cancel or Pause a Sunbasket Subscription

Sunbasket offers a straightforward cancellation system that you can manage entirely through its website:

  1. Log into your account and click the 'Manage My Subscription' link on your account settings page.
  2. Follow the prompts to cancel your subscription. Sunbasket will ask for your reason for canceling.
  3. You may be offered alternatives to cancellation, but if you wish to proceed, select 'No' to confirm your cancellation request.
  4. Wait for a confirmation email, which will verify that your cancellation has been processed.

Account Changes

To modify your Sunbasket account:

  1. Log in and navigate to the 'My Account' section
  2. Edit meal plans by clicking the Edit icon under 'Meal Plan'
  3. Change passwords under the 'Account' section
  4. Update delivery addresses via the Edit icon under 'Delivery Information'
  5. Modify billing details through the Edit icon in 'Payment & Billing'

Weekly Delivery Management

All changes must be made by Wednesday at Noon PST / 3 pm EST before the delivery week.

Simply follow these steps:

  1. Select weekly meals in the 'My Menu' section
  2. View past orders in 'Rate Order'
  3. Skip a week through the 'Schedule' page
  4. Cancel subscriptions via the provided cancellation link
  5. Forward deliveries to alternate addresses when traveling

Is There a Sunbasket App?

Sunbasket has a user-friendly mobile app available for iOS and Android devices. You can easily manage your subscription, select meals, and track deliveries from your smartphone.

The app has recently been updated to improve its stability and speed. You'll notice a redesigned menu navigation, including a new Pre-Made Meals aisle. This section showcases all single-serving Fresh & Ready and Prepared & Ready meals, which you can prepare in five minutes or less.

These updates enhance your experience and make meal selection even more convenient. If you have any comments or suggestions, you can send them directly to ux@sunbasket.com.

How Much Does Sunbasket Cost?

Note: Actual costs may vary based on specific meal selections. Meals with meat or seafood typically cost more than vegetarian options. Shipping is free for your first box.

PlanPrice per mealServingsShipping costs
Meal kitsFrom $11.49Two to five servings$9.99 per box
Ready-made mealsFrom $9.99One serving$9.99 per box

Sunbasket uses a la carte pricing, with meal kits ranging from $11.49 to $24.49 per serving. Each order has a $45 minimum. Sunbasket can be somewhat pricey compared to its competitors, like HelloFresh and Green Chef. However, you pay for high-quality, mostly organic ingredients and responsible sourcing.

Cost example for one week (four meals for two people):

  • Four meal kits at $11.49 each: $91.92
  • Shipping: $9.99
  • Total: $101.91

Optional Add Ons

Market Items

Sunbasket's Market offers diverse ready-to-eat items and ingredients to complement its meal kits and cater to various dining needs throughout the day. Quick breakfast options like Petite Breakfast Quiche Lorraine and Overnight Oats are perfect for busy mornings.

There are pre-made salads such as the Wedge Salad with Bacon and Blue Cheese or the Pesto Caprese Tomato Salad for lunch or light dinners. The Market also provides a selection of smoothies, juices, and probiotic drinks.

You can also order several types of pasta, sauces, snacks for weight loss, and proteins like seafood, beef, and poultry. Items are priced individually and can be easily added to your order each week using the Sunbasket website or app.

Refer-a-Friend Program

Sunbasket's Refer-a-Friend program allows you to give friends up to $90 off their first four deliveries, and you'll receive $40 when they join. This is a great way to introduce friends to the service while earning rewards for yourself.

Send to a Friend

You can forward your Sunbasket as a care package or surprise gift to a friend. This feature is particularly popular for new parents or anyone who could use a break from meal planning.

Gift Cards

Sunbasket offers gift cards in any amount, which can be scheduled for delivery with a personalized note on your chosen date. This makes it easy to gift delicious, healthy meals to friends and family.

Bottom Line

Sunbasket is a great choice to save time on meal planning and cooking without sacrificing quality. Whether you're cooking for yourself, your partner, or your family, you'll find various chef-developed recipes to suit different tastes and dietary needs. While it's pricier than some other services, you're paying for organic, sustainable ingredients and innovative recipes.

You'll appreciate the flexibility to customize your meal plan, skip weeks, or pause your subscription as needed. Sunbasket could answer your "what's for dinner?" dilemma if you value high-quality, healthy meal delivery services.

However, buying groceries can be slightly more affordable if you compare the two. There's more to it than just price tough. Consider how food kits can conveniently override the cost difference by the gas and time saved.

I use my medical nutrition training and clinical experience to analyze daily nutritional requirements, actual food costs, and effective planning that meets nourishment needs on any budget. In this article, I leverage that to compare the true differences in value between meal kits and groceries to help you make the right choice for your needs.

How Do Meal Kits Save You on Fuel Costs?

With constant inflation and rising gas prices, home-cooked food is becoming more and more expensive to prepare. Meal kits may be the budget-friendly option. Instead of taking regular trips to the grocery store, you can have your food delivered right to your doorstep.

A weekly food kit delivery uses less fuel and lowers the bottom line of costs. For instance, if you don't effectively plan your weekly meals and visit the grocery store multiple times a week, the fuel cost could be higher than that of a scheduled food kit delivery.

Many delivery services, including Factor and Nutrisystem, offer free or discounted shipping.

Do Meal Kits Impact the Environment and Food Waste?

Deliveries offer a few ways to lower food waste and reduce your carbon footprint.

Companies like Home Chef use sustainable and recyclable packaging. Kits with pre-portioned ingredients save you from buying ingredients in bulk that may expire and end up in the bin.

Every order gives you the perfect amount needed for each meal. This approach minimizes waste and contributes to a more sustainable food supply chain. Food delivery companies like HelloFresh use sustainable farming suppliers to lessen their environmental impact.

How Do Food Kits Save You Time?

Grocery shopping takes more time than ever, and I feel people like me have better things to do than endlessly browsing stores and waiting in queues.

Oven-ready meal delivery services can also cut your cooking time.

Kits provide you with food you can prepare in advance for the whole week. This means no daily chopping and portioning.

However, consider the trade-off between the convenience of meal kits and the experience of cooking from scratch, which you may prefer. While deliveries offer quick and easy meals, they might not provide the same satisfaction that some get from selecting ingredients and cooking from scratch.

Why Choose Meal Kits Instead of Grocery Stores?

In today’s fast-paced world, meal delivery kits have become a convenient alternative to traditional grocery shopping. Here are some reasons why I choose meal delivery kits over groceries:

  • Convenience: Meal kits save you the time and effort of planning, prepping, and cooking. Everything you need is delivered right to your doorstep.
  • Portion control and calorie management: There are many reasons why portion control is important. One motivating factor is to help you manage your calorie intake.
  • Freshness and quality of ingredients: Fresh and high-quality ingredients are used regularly. Many services emphasize organic or locally sourced items, appealing to health-conscious consumers.
  • Fewer impulse purchases: You get exactly what you need for each recipe, reducing impulse shopping. This can lead to savings and less food waste.
  • Culinary skill development: Kits come with step-by-step recipes, making them a great way to develop your cooking techniques. This expands your culinary horizons and adds variety to your diet.
  • Customization options: You can choose meals according to your taste preferences and dietary needs like meat-free and gluten-free foods.

  2. Sunbasket: Sunbasket offers kits with unique flavor combinations of high-quality produce. They provide nutrient-dense and organic food that their in-house dietitians approve. You can get a meal kit from Sunbasket for $13.99 per serving.

FAQs

Do meal kits actually save money?

Yes, meal kits can save you money. They reduce food waste with portion control, helping you throw away less food. You avoid impulse buying and unnecessary grocery purchases. You also save on gas and time by not making frequent trips to the grocery store. Overall, cheap meal delivery services offer a cost-effective solution for meal planning.

Are meal delivery services cheaper than eating out?

Yes, meal delivery services are often cheaper than eating out. They provide meals at a lower cost per serving compared to restaurant prices. And by purchasing ingredients in bulk, meal delivery services can pass on savings to customers. Additionally, preparing meals at home reduces the cost of beverages, desserts, and other extras that quickly add up when dining out.

Is a meal kit worth it for one person?

Affordable meal delivery services like HelloFresh offer convenience and variety for singles. They help you enjoy fresh and diverse meals without overspending.

What is the difference between meal kits and food delivery?

Meal kits include pre-measured ingredients you cook yourself, offering a fresh, home-cooked experience. In contrast, food delivery services bring you prepared meals from restaurants.

How Meal Delivery Services Work

Meal delivery services are designed to simplify the process of eating healthy by taking care of the meal planning and grocery shopping for you. Here’s a step-by-step look at how these services typically work:

  1. Sign Up and Choose a Plan: First, you’ll need to sign up on the meal delivery service’s website. Most services offer a variety of plans based on the number of meals per week and the number of servings per meal. You can choose a plan that fits your lifestyle, whether you’re cooking for just yourself, a couple, or a family.
  2. Select Your Meals: Once you’ve chosen a plan, you’ll be able to select your meals from a weekly menu. These menus often include a variety of options to accommodate different dietary preferences and restrictions, such as vegetarian, vegan, low-carb, gluten-free, or keto. Many services provide detailed nutritional information for each meal, helping you make informed choices.
  3. Delivery to Your Doorstep: After you’ve made your selections, the service will pack all the necessary ingredients into a box and deliver it to your home. Deliveries are typically scheduled to ensure the freshness of the ingredients, and most services use insulated packaging to keep perishable items cold during transit.
  4. Pre-Portioned Ingredients: The ingredients are pre-portioned, meaning you’ll receive exactly what you need for each recipe, reducing food waste. These pre-measured ingredients save you time on prep work and help you avoid buying more than you need.
  5. Follow the Recipe Cards: Each meal kit comes with a recipe card that includes step-by-step instructions. These cards are designed to be easy to follow, even for those with limited cooking experience. They often include pictures to guide you through the cooking process.
  6. Cook and Enjoy: With everything you need at your fingertips, you can cook your meal with ease. Most recipes are designed to be ready in 30 minutes or less, making it convenient for busy schedules. Once cooked, you can enjoy a delicious, healthy meal without the stress of planning or shopping.

Meal delivery services not only save time but also encourage healthier eating habits by providing balanced, nutritious meals. Whether you’re looking to try new recipes, improve your cooking skills, or simply maintain a healthy diet, these services offer a practical and enjoyable solution.

How to Stay Healthy With Meal Kits

Meal kits can be a great way to maintain a healthy diet. To make the most of them, start by choosing nutritious options. Opt for meal plans that emphasize whole foods, lean proteins, and plenty of vegetables. Many services offer specific plans for various dietary needs, such as low-carb, high-protein, or plant-based diets.

Reviewing the nutritional information provided for each meal is crucial. Look for options that are lower in sodium, added sugars, and unhealthy fats. Aim for balanced meals that provide a good mix of macronutrients and vitamins.

Portion control is another benefit of meal kits, as they are pre-portioned to help prevent overeating, which is particularly beneficial if you’re managing your weight or adhering to a specific dietary regimen.

Additionally, meal kits often introduce you to new ingredients and recipes, helping you diversify your diet and discover healthier foods you might not have tried otherwise.

Consistency is key to maintaining a healthy diet, and with meal kits, you can ensure you have healthy meals planned and ready to cook, reducing the temptation to opt for less healthy takeout or convenience foods.

How to Save Money With Meal Kits

Using meal kits can be a cost-effective way to enjoy home-cooked meals. Here are some tips to help you save money with meal kits:

Look for Promotions: Many meal delivery services offer discounts for first-time customers, seasonal promotions, or referral bonuses. Take advantage of these deals to reduce your initial costs.

Choose the Right Plan: Select a meal plan that fits your budget. Some plans offer larger portions or family-sized meals, which can provide better value per serving.

Reduce Food Waste: Meal kits provide pre-portioned ingredients, which means you only get what you need for each recipe. This helps minimize food waste and ensures you're not spending money on excess ingredients that might go unused.

Compare Prices: Before committing to a service, compare the prices of different meal kits. Look at the cost per serving and consider any additional fees for shipping or premium ingredients.

Skip Weeks When Needed: Most meal delivery services offer flexible subscription options that allow you to skip weeks when you don’t need a delivery. This can help you manage your budget and avoid paying for meals you won’t use.

What to Consider When Buying Healthy Meal Delivery

When selecting a healthy meal delivery service, consider your dietary needs and preferences. Check if the service offers menus that cater to specific diets like vegetarian, low-carb, or allergen-free.

Look at the ingredient quality – organic, non-GMO, and sustainably sourced ingredients are often a good sign of a healthy meal delivery service. Evaluate the flexibility of the subscription plans, including the ease of skipping weeks or canceling.

Read reviews to understand the taste and freshness of the meals, as well as the reliability of the delivery service. Finally, consider the cost per serving and ensure it fits within your budget while still providing nutritious, satisfying meals.

Eat Healthy Without the Hassle

Subscribing to a healthy meal delivery service can revolutionize your diet and save you time. With a service like Factor or HelloFresh, you can easily maintain a nutritious lifestyle without the hassle of meal planning, grocery shopping, and cooking.

Plus, you'll be able to try new, exciting recipes and expand your culinary horizons. Whether you're a busy professional, a health-conscious individual, or simply looking to simplify your meal routine, a healthy meal delivery service can be an excellent solution.

A seemingly harmless protein found in wheat, barley, and rye could be the hidden cause of discomfort for many people. An individual with gluten sensitivity most likely experiences uncomfortable symptoms after eating cereals, bread, pasta, sauces, and chocolates. Indicators of gluten intolerance can vary widely among individuals, and some may experience non-digestive symptoms.

A gluten-free diet is a food and lifestyle adjustment. Different gluten-free options provided by various meal delivery services are ideal if you want to remove gluten from your daily intake. I’m a certified nutritionist, and I’ll walk you through the types of gluten intolerance and the ten most common indicators.

Celiac Disease vs. NCGS vs. Wheat Allergy

There are three types of gluten intolerance:

  1. Celiac or coeliac disease: An auto-immune disease and the most severe form of gluten intolerance
  2. Non-celiac gluten sensitivity (NCGS): Intolerance exhibited in people without celiac disease
  3. Wheat allergy: An allergic reaction caused by eating wheat products, foods containing wheat proteins, or inhaling wheat flour

Symptoms can overlap between these conditions, making distinguishing them challenging without a medical test. These overlapping indicators may differ in severity. For example, Celiac Disease can cause significant intestinal damage, while NCGS might not cause long-term harm but can be uncomfortable.

1. Bloating

Bloating occurs when an individual experiences a tight and full feeling in the abdomen due to gas. It's a widespread symptom of intolerance, but it's important to note that bloating is caused by various digestive issues, not just gluten.

Therefore, distinguishing it specifically as a sign of gluten intolerance requires considering other related symptoms and dietary habits. Wheat, rye, and barley are high in gluten; regular consumption can increase your body's gluten sensitivity over time.

It may also create digestive issues like gas and flatulence, abdominal pain, acid reflux, and heartburn. The typical severity and duration of bloating can vary. However, it can present as a consistent discomfort after eating gluten-free foods.

If you notice ongoing or severe swelling, it's wise to seek medical advice. This is essential to rule out more extreme conditions and receive appropriate dietary management guidance.

2. Abdominal Pain

If you experience frequent stomach pain, especially after eating gluten-free food products, you should get checked for intolerance, celiac disease, or a wheat allergy. This pain often manifests as a sharp or cramping sensation in the lower or mid-abdomen.

Research shows that wheat or foods containing gluten can trigger inflammation and pain in patients with celiac disease. The pain usually occurs within a few hours after consuming gluten and varies in severity. It’s important to note that the intensity of pain does not always correlate with the level of gluten intolerance or the extent of damage in celiac disease.

 Gluten-intolerant adults often display abdominal pain. If your pain is severe, persistent, or accompanied by other symptoms, such as blood in the stool, you should seek medical help promptly. This could be indicative of a more serious condition requiring further attention.

3. Diarrhea or Constipation

Constipation or runny stools can point to gluten sensitivity, specifically celiac disease. Rather than occasional occurrences, chronic looseness of the bowels or consistent constipation might indicate a problem.

When your body does not digest gluten-based foods well, the result is diarrhea with pale and foul-smelling feces, sometimes followed by rapid weight loss. This type of runny tummy, especially in celiac disease, often shows signs of malabsorption, such as greasy, floating stools that are unusually smelly.

 Constipation occurs in many individuals. However, frequent constipation without any underlying cause may signify non-celiac gluten intolerance. Ongoing constipation can lead to nutritional deficiencies as nutrients are not adequately absorbed. In a gluten-free diet, sufficient hydration and dietary fiber are crucial to manage this symptom.

Yet achieving this can be challenging if not carefully managed. One resolution could be to try gluten-free meal kits carefully created by delivery services like HelloFresh. Many individuals notice a significant improvement in symptoms when they remove gluten from their food options.

Go for a medical evaluation to rule out other causes of chronic diarrhea or constipation, as these signs can be common to various gastrointestinal disorders. Get medical attention if there is blood in your stool or acute pain or if symptoms persist and do not respond to dietary changes.

4. Headaches

Headaches are a common symptom of fever, colds, and eye strain. But, you may experience frequent migraine attacks without any other medical conditions. In this case, a doctor may suspect gluten intolerance. If that is the case, these head pains can often be more persistent and severe compared to those caused by other factors.

They may last longer and be accompanied by nausea or sensitivity to light, distinguishing them from typical tension headaches. It's important to consider other aspects of your lifestyle that may contribute to frequent migraines. Factors such as stress, dehydration, or lack of sleep can also trigger head pain.

Scientific studies show that headaches may be caused by gluten intolerance, specifically celiac disease. Therefore, while considering gluten intolerance, address other areas of your lifestyle to help manage your migraines.

5. Fatigue

Fatigue is a common symptom of autoimmune disorders. Since celiac disease is an autoimmune disorder, individuals diagnosed with it may experience regular tiredness. This exhaustion is often more persistent and severe compared to general weariness.

Unlike normal tiredness that can be fixed with rest, gluten-related fatigue can linger and significantly impact daily functioning. Iron deficiency anemia is another condition that occurs due to celiac disease. The production of red blood cells in the body lowers, leaving you tired.

Moreover, celiac disease often leads to malabsorption of vitamin B12, folate, and other essential nutrients vital for producing energy. These deficiencies can contribute to the severity of fatigue experienced. You can eat foods like spinach, shellfish, pumpkin seeds, and red meat to increase your iron levels and help improve your energy levels.

Individuals with non-celiac gluten sensitivity also include exhaustion as a common symptom. One study found that out of 486 people suspected of non-celiac gluten sensitivity, 64% reported that they experienced tiredness.

6. Mood Disorders

You may experience mood disorders or extreme anxiety from gluten sensitivity. People who are gluten intolerant can have brain inflammation that manifests as increased anxiety. Anxiety can lead to depression and bring about intense worry or agitation. This impact of gluten on the brain can lead to mood imbalances like depression and irritability.

The link between celiac disease and mental health issues is complex and not fully understood. However, mood disorders are more prevalent in those with gluten sensitivity or celiac disease. Studies have shown that people who are gluten intolerant may experience anxiety and depression.

Deficiencies in essential nutrients like omega-3 fatty acids and B vitamins can also influence mood imbalances. Suitable diets provided by meal kit services like Nutrisystem can help relieve some symptoms.

Also, consider psychological support alongside dietary changes to help manage your mood. This condition can significantly impact your quality of life.

» What's for supper tonight? Taste these yummy gluten-free dinner ideas.

7. Muscle and Joint Pain

When gluten is consumed, it can lead to an inflammatory reaction in the body, resulting in muscle and joint pain. These aches can be localized in certain areas or widespread. They may be constant or intermittent, depending on your response.

It's essential to differentiate gluten-induced joint and muscle pain from other causes, such as arthritis or other autoimmune disorders. While these conditions can show similar symptoms, the underlying causes are distinct.

Studies confirm that gluten intolerance can trigger fibromyalgia, a condition that causes intense pain throughout muscles and their associated joints.

8. Brain Fog

Mental fog is a condition where you're unable to think clearly. You may experience forgetfulness, fatigue, confusion, a clouded mind, or difficulty concentrating. If you encounter these symptoms, you should check with a medical professional to rule out gluten sensitivity.

Various conditions can cause brain fog. Potential causes include sleep disorders, stress, or nutritional deficiencies. It's important to rule these out when diagnosing the cause of your clouded mind. The link between your gastrointestinal health and cognitive function is known as the gut-brain axis.

It suggests that issues caused by gluten intolerance can impact the mind. This connection shows how an abnormal absorption of gluten through an alteration in the small intestinal barrier can affect the central nervous system. It's worth noting that celiac disease can also cause brain fog.

9. Skin Conditions

Gluten sensitivity can create skin problems ranging from mild to severe in people with celiac disease. Conditions include psoriasis, alopecia areata, and dermatitis herpetiformis. Dermatitis herpetiformis, in particular, is directly linked to celiac disease and is characterized by itchy or burning blisters and rashes. They appear most commonly on your elbows, knees, and buttocks. The rash often has a symmetrical pattern.

Skin problems are not exclusive to celiac disease. Individuals with NCGS can also experience irritations. These may manifest as rashes, eczema, and dryness.

Skin reactions in gluten intolerance involve the immune system's response to gluten, which can trigger inflammation in the skin. Furthermore, nutrient deficiencies due to impaired absorption can also affect epidermal health, exacerbating or starting issues.

10. Infertility

Reproductive changes are becoming increasingly prevalent in people with gluten intolerance. Gluten can sometimes be the culprit in unexplained infertility, especially for anyone with celiac disease. The range of associated gluten intolerance reproductive issues includes menstrual irregularities, recurrent miscarriages, and delayed puberty.

The possible reason for infertility is poor nutrient absorption, specifically of zinc, iron, folate, and selenium. For instance, zinc affects the production of healthy sperm and eggs, and Iron transports oxygen to the reproductive organs.

This condition is not exclusive to women; gluten intolerance can also affect male fertility, impacting sperm quality and quantity. Consult with fertility specialists and possibly a gastroenterologist for a comprehensive approach to managing your infertility related to gluten intolerance.

Coping With Gluten Sensitivity

The best way to manage your intolerance is to understand the symptoms and take steps to prevent them. Educate yourself on food nutrition and hidden sources of gluten and read product labels to identify ingredients and contact online communities for advice.

Know what to eat to make it easier, whether you prefer to prepare food at home or dine out. Gluten-free meal delivery services like Sunbasket or Home Chef are safe options if you enjoy the convenience of ordering meals that can cater to your nutritional needs.

Along with the proper medical intervention, food choices, and dietary adherence, you can help effectively cope with your gluten intolerance.

articles.title: 10 Fat-Burning, High-Protein Meals Pescatarians Love
articles.subtitle: A pescatarian diet allows seafood but is otherwise vegetarian. Pescatarian meals are high in protein and nutrients, low in carbs, and great for burning fat. Here are 10 fat-burning, high-protein pescatarian meals.
articles.summary: A pescatarian diet allows seafood but is otherwise vegetarian. Pescatarian meals are high in protein and nutrients, low in carbs, and great for burning fat. Here are 10 fat-burning, high-protein pescatarian meals.
articles.mainContent:
This diet form has been prevalent for some time and is considered extremely beneficial. The high omega-3 fatty acids can help fight against cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, hypertension, and even cancer. A pescatarian diet has also been said to increase longevity and improve overall health.

Many people from coastal areas practice this diet form naturally. However, it's easy for anyone to follow a pescatarian diet these days, especially with meal delivery. The best meal delivery services offer delicious, easy-to-prepare pescatarian meal kits. You can even use a vegetarian meal delivery service and add your choice of fish at home.

Whatever you decide, having fish with plant-based protein sources can be an extremely effective way to burn fat. Here are 10 fat-burning, high-protein pescatarian meals for you to try.

1. Feta Tomato-Basil Fish

This high-protein pescatarian dish is an instant hit. It's delicious and super easy to make!

You can use bass, walleye, or tilapia. White fish is low-calorie and low-carb and contains plenty of protein—perfect for triggering fat burning. Feta cheese contains conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), which supports fat burning and improves body composition.

Tomatoes boost lipid metabolism and help reduce body fat and cholesterol. They stimulate the production of carnitine, an amino acid that promotes fat burning. Tomato also increases good cholesterol (HDL) in the body (1).

Ingredients

Olive oil, chopped onion, garlic, can of diced Italian tomatoes, fresh basil, white fish fillets, and crumbled feta cheese.

Method

Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions and garlic until translucent. Toss in tomatoes and chopped basil, and allow to come to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes.

Top fish fillets with tomato mixture and feta. Broil for about 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

2. Avocado Crab Boats

Avocado crab boats are high in protein, low in carbs, and high in good fats.

The monounsaturated fatty acids in avocado can actually increase the rate at which fat is burned in your body. In addition, it reduces appetite and aids weight loss. Crab meat is low in fat and rich in essential nutrients that are beneficial to your health.

Ingredients

Avocadoes, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, crabmeat, chopped cilantro, and cayenne pepper.

Method

Mix Greek yogurt, lemon juice, crabmeat, cilantro, and cayenne pepper in a bowl. Cut the avocadoes in half and remove the pit. Spoon the crab mixture into the avocado and serve.

3. Zucchini Spaghetti With Garlic Butter Shrimp

Garlic butter shrimp with zoodles are a match made in heaven. It has juicy shrimps and nutrient-rich zucchini—all made in less than 30 minutes! You can't go wrong with these low-carb, low-fat zucchini noodles!

Zucchinis are low in calories and have a high water content, helping you lose weight. The fibers make you feel full for longer. Zucchinis also contain vitamin B6, which regulates fat metabolism.

Ingredients

Butter, minced garlic and shallot, zucchini noodles, peeled and deveined shrimp, chopped parsley, and lemon juice.

Method

In a pan, melt butter and cook garlic until fragrant. Add zoodles and toss in the pan until tender. Remove from the heat and set aside.

In a skillet, melt butter and cook garlic and shallot until fragrant. Add shrimp and allow to cook through. Toss shrimp with zoodles and top with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.

4. Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps

Tuna is a great choice for fish lovers. It is very high in protein and low in calories. It also reduces the hunger hormone ghrelin, decreasing your overall food intake.

The omega-3 fatty acids in tuna help turn off fat genes (2). On top of that, the red cabbage, baby spinach, and kale in the salad contain organic compounds that help burn belly fat.

Ingredients

Light mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, canned tuna, diced red onion, baby spinach, chopped kale, and large lettuce leaves.

Method

Mix mayonnaise, yogurt, tuna, red onion, baby spinach, and kale in a bowl. Spoon tuna mixture onto lettuce leaves and roll into wraps.

5. Fish Tacos With Black Beans

These fish tacos are high protein, low fat, and highly nutritious.

Black beans are high in soluble fibers that help decrease fat around the waist. As mentioned previously, avocado triggers fat burning. The red bell peppers and cabbage are good sources of dietary fibers and antioxidants.

Ingredients

Black beans, diced red onions, sliced red bell peppers, shredded cabbage, diced avocado, lime juice, white fish, taco seasoning, corn tortillas, and chopped cilantro.

Method

In a bowl, mix black beans, red onions, red bell peppers, shredded cabbage, avocado, and lime juice. Coat fish with taco seasoning and grill until cooked. Place a spoonful of the black bean mixture onto a tortilla and top with grilled fish.

Tip: To elevate your tacos, top them with salsa, shredded cheese, or sour cream.

6. Classic Norwegian Fish Soup

A bowl of classic Norwegian fish soup is the perfect comfort food and any pescatarian’s dream.

Haddock is low in calories, has a low mercury content, and is high in protein. It is a good source of vitamin B6, B12, magnesium, and selenium. Most of these minerals help boost your metabolism and burn fat.

Ingredients

Butter, flour, fish stock, haddock fillets, carrots (cut into strips), diced celeriac, sliced leeks, lemon juice, egg yolks, double cream, cayenne pepper, and chopped chives.

Method

In a large pot, melt butter and add flour and fish stock. Whisk until smooth. Add carrots, celeriac, and leeks to the soup and allow to boil for about 15 minutes.

In a bowl, mix lemon juice, egg yolks, cream, and cayenne pepper. Add the egg mixture to the soup with haddock fillets. Simmer until the fish is cooked through, and serve with a sprinkling of chopped chives.

7. Salmon Avocado Salad

Apart from being a good source of protein, salmon contains omega-3 fatty acids that improve digestion. The protein and omega-3 fatty acids in salmon help prevent insulin spikes, creating a condition where the body can burn stored fat for energy.

Ingredients

Olive oil, salmon fillets, chopped red onion, halved cherry tomatoes, diced avocado, chopped lettuce, and sliced cucumber.

Method

In a pan, heat olive oil and cook salmon fillets. Combine red onion, cherry tomatoes, avocado, lettuce, and cucumber.

Top with cooked salmon and drizzle over dressing of your choice.

8. Edamame-Rye Crusted Sea Bass

Sea bass is low in fat and high in protein and a great alternative to red and processed meat, which is full of saturated fat.

One cup of edamame contains 8 grams of fiber and 17 grams of protein. They also contain phytoestrogens that help reduce fat accumulation by inhibiting the life cycle of fat cells.

Ingredients

Butter, chopped edamame, rye bread crumbs, chopped chives, sea bass fillets

Method

In a skillet, melt butter and cook chopped edamame. Mix in bread crumbs and chives, and set aside. In another skillet, cook the fish fillets and top with edamame crust. Serve with a side of your choice.

9. Cornmeal Catfish

Catfish has a great nutritional profile and can be appropriate in a pescatarian diet for boosting fat burning. You can get about 18 grams of protein from 100 grams of catfish. It also contains a good amount of vitamin B12, selenium, phosphorus, thiamine, and potassium.

Ingredients

Yellow cornmeal, flour, seasonings of your choice, catfish fillets, oil for frying, asparagus

Method

Mix cornmeal, flour, and seasonings in a bowl. Evenly coat catfish fillets in cornmeal mixture and shallow fry until cooked and golden brown.

Tip: Serve with a side of grilled asparagus. It is low in calories, high in water, and rich in fiber. It contains asparagine, an alkaloid that breaks down fat cells.

10. Lime Broiled Salmon With Red Bell Peppers

Salmon contains all nine essential amino acids, making it a complete protein source. This fatty fish is loaded with selenium, phosphorus, and plenty of B vitamins.

Red bell peppers contain an active compound called capsaicin that has been found to increase the fat-burning rate (3). The vitamin C found in red bell pepper boosts fat burning by increasing fat oxidation by nearly 30% (4).

Ingredients

Lime juice, soy sauce, finely chopped ginger, honey, salmon fillets, and sliced red bell peppers.

Method

Mix lime juice, soy sauce, ginger, and honey. Pour over salmon fillets and allow to marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to an hour. Broil until salmon is flaky and serve with sliced red peppers.

Tip: Occasionally brush salmon with leftover marinade while broiling or reduce it in a saucepan to pour over cooked salmon.

Pescatarian Meals Can Improve Your Overall Health

Pescatarian meals are low in calories and high in protein. They provide the perfect way to improve your overall health, especially when enjoyed with healthy, nutrient-rich sides.

If you want to try a few pescatarian meals but just can't find the time to prepare them, look no further than meal delivery services like Home Chef and Sunbasket.

articles.title: Top Ten Keto Foods Rich in Fiber
articles.subtitle: Fruits and vegetables are high in fiber, but most of them are not allowed on a keto diet. To enjoy the benefits of a keto diet, you can have only 20–50 grams of carbs per day. This makes it difficult to maintain ketosis while getting enough fiber in your diet. Thankfully, these high-fiber foods can do the job.

This makes it difficult to maintain ketosis while getting enough fiber in your diet. Thankfully, these high-fiber foods can do the job.
articles.mainContent:
The keto diet is a low-carb, high-fat diet with a moderate amount of protein. Unfortunately, most high-fat or protein-based foods such as fish, eggs, and meat tend to be low in fiber. Fiber is vital for many of our body functions, especially digestion. It has a substantial impact on gut and even heart health.

Meal delivery services like Home Chef and Factor_ can help you get enough fiber in your diet by delivering balanced, keto-friendly meals right to your doorstep. If you're low on time or simply not a fan of the kitchen, keto-friendly meal delivery services make sticking to your diet a breeze.

That being said, here are the 10 high-fiber keto foods to promote good gut and heart health.

1. Avocado

With their unique buttery flavor, avocados can be added to various dishes, from salads to dips and more. They are rich in healthy fats and contain many nutrients such as vitamins C and K, potassium, and folate.

This keto-friendly food is high in fiber, with a small avocado offering about 9 grams of fiber and just 3 grams of carbs.

Avocadoes are quite versatile and can be enjoyed in many different ways. Guacamole is probably the most popular avocado dish. Avocado egg salad is great for a quick lunch, and avocado chips are perfect for low-carb nibbling.

2. Coconut Meat

Coconut meat refers to the white flesh inside a coconut, which is rich in fiber and healthy fats. It offers many important minerals, including manganese and copper. With just 2 grams of carbs, an ounce of shredded coconut meat provides 5 grams of fiber.

You can munch on pieces of coconut meat or add shredded coconut to any recipe of your choice. It adds a comforting nutty flavor to sweet and savory dishes. No-bake coconut dessert bars, coconut macaroons, and toasted coconut chips are popular keto recipes made with coconut meat.

3. Blackberries

Most berries are keto-friendly and rich in antioxidants. Regular consumption of berries is linked to a reduced risk of heart disease.

Blackberries are especially rich in vitamin C, with a cup of this sweet and tart fruit offering over 30% of the recommended allowance for vitamin C. Eating blackberries daily can boost insulin sensitivity and burn fat (1). A cup of blackberries contains 6 grams of carbs and 7 grams of fiber.

From keto blackberry cobbler, blackberry bars, and low-carb blackberry cheesecake, blackberries can be added to plenty of recipes to increase your fiber intake in the most delicious ways.

4. Mushrooms

Mushrooms are rich in nutrients, including vitamin B and potassium. With a range of B-vitamins such as riboflavin, niacin, and pantothenic acid, mushrooms benefit heart health.

A cup of oyster mushrooms has 3.6 grams of carbs with 2 grams of fiber, and the same amount of Portobello mushrooms offers you 3.1 grams of carbs with 1.3 grams of fiber.

Creamy garlic mushrooms, pan-fried mushrooms with bacon, sausage-stuffed mushrooms, or simply stir-fried mushrooms with a sauce of your choice—the options are endless.

5. Cauliflower

Cauliflower, a cruciferous vegetable, is quite popular in keto diets as it can be used as a grain substitute. It is low in calories and high in fiber, vitamins, and minerals.

Cauliflower also contains choline, an essential nutrient similar to B-vitamins. Choline gets converted into a neurotransmitter that is vital for many bodily functions, including muscle contractions and brain health (2).

With 2 grams of carbs, a cup of chopped cauliflower also offers 2 grams of fiber. You can make keto bread or keto pizza crust using cauliflower, and keto cauliflower mash is a close substitute for mashed potatoes. Add some herbs, cheese, and fresh cream to make it decadent and irresistible.

6. Broccoli

Another cruciferous vegetable that offers you some protein as well is broccoli. It is low in calories, high in fiber, and rich in nutrients such as vitamins K and C, potassium, and folate.

To ensure you get the most of its benefits, eat it steamed in soups, salads, or as a buttered, crunchy side dish. A cup of broccoli has about 3 grams of carbs and 2 grams of fiber. Cheesy broccoli casseroles and creamy broccoli and cheddar soup are quick and delicious keto recipes you can include in your cooking routine.

7. Asparagus

Although many people think asparagus is green, this springtime vegetable has different variants. They come in a variety of colors, such as green, white, and purple, and can be eaten raw or cooked.

Asparagus is high in fiber, low in calories, and offers you almost half of your daily requirement for vitamin K. Asparagus also contains a good amount of folate, a nutrient that’s vital during pregnancy. With three grams of fiber, a cup of asparagus has just 2 grams of carbs.

You can have asparagus as a side dish or snack. Try sautéing it in some garlic butter or roasting them in the oven.

8. Eggplant

Eggplants have a meaty texture. Despite its bulky appearance, this vegetable is quite low in calories and a great fiber source. It also contains many other nutrients, such as potassium and manganese. This superfood also contains notable amounts of copper, folate, thiamine, and vitamins A, C, and K. A cup of chopped eggplant has 2 grams of carbs and 3 grams of fiber.

Eggplant pizzas are quite popular in the keto world. Drizzle some olive oil on a baking tray and arrange eggplant slices. Add your choice of pizza toppings, cover generously with mozzarella cheese, and bake. Delicious!

9. Purple Cabbage

While purple cabbages taste similar to green or white cabbage, they have higher amounts of helpful plant compounds in them. Its bright color comes from anthocyanins, a plant compound known for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. These are highly beneficial for our immune system.

Purple cabbages have high amounts of vitamin C, even more than oranges. Numerous vitamins and minerals are present in this miracle vegetable. It contains calcium, iron, and manganese along with Vitamin B6, folate, retinol, and Vitamin K. With 5 grams of carbs and 2 grams of fiber, a cup of chopped red cabbage is ideal for a ketogenic diet.

You can make a simple stir-fry with purple cabbage keto noodles, and purple cabbage slaws are great for topping keto nachos.

10. Chia Seeds

Well known for their impressive omega-3 content, chia seeds pack quite a powerful punch despite their size. They have numerous vitamins and minerals, including protein and fiber.

Chia seeds absorb a lot of liquid and turn into a jelly-like form, so they are often used as a vegan sauce thickener and egg replacement in various recipes. Two tablespoons of this wonder seed offer you 2 grams of carbs and a whopping 11 grams of fiber.

Add them to smoothies or sprinkle them on top of salads. Creamy chia seed puddings are quite popular as a sweet treat on keto, so try making blueberry chia smoothies with almond or coconut milk.

Getting Enough Fiber on a Keto Diet Doesn't Have to Be Complicated

With such versatile and delicious keto foods on your grocery list, you will have no trouble increasing your fiber intake while keeping the carbs low. You can reap the rewards of following a keto diet and the numerous benefits associated with dietary fiber.

Follow a proper keto diet guide to lower your insulin levels, reduce unwanted body fat, and achieve your goals of being healthy and fit.

References

  2. https://www.hsph.harvard.edu/nutritionsource/choline/

comparison.wysiwygContent:
Finding the perfect meal delivery service can be a game-changer for your daily routine. Whether you're looking to save time on meal prep, eat healthier, or simply enjoy the convenience of having delicious meals delivered right to your door, we've got you covered.

Our comprehensive guide to the best meal delivery services will help you find the perfect fit for your lifestyle and dietary needs. From the cheapest meal prep services to gourmet selections, there's something here for everyone. Even if you’re a stranger to the kitchen, you can throw together fantastic meals that’ll have you forgetting about pizza deliveries. It’s meal prep made easy.

What is a Meal Delivery Service?

A meal delivery service brings the convenience of pre-planned, pre-portioned, and sometimes pre-cooked meals directly to your home. The best home delivery meals ensure that you can enjoy nutritious and delicious meals without the hassle of grocery shopping or meal prep.

While food delivery services offering pre-cooked food have been around for hundreds of years, meal kit services are a relatively new development that started in 2003 in Scandinavia and spread to the United States in 2012. These companies enjoyed a surge in popularity during the pandemic and have continued to be a popular choice for people who want to save time, try new recipes, and reduce food waste.

The best meal subscription services offer a range of options catering to different lifestyles, so they’re a great choice if you’re looking for something specific, like high-protein meal delivery, gluten-free options, weight-loss plans, or meal deliveries for the elderly.

What Types of Meal Delivery Services Are There?

Meal kits

Meal kits provide all the ingredients you need to cook a meal at home, along with easy-to-follow instructions. They’re perfect for those who enjoy cooking but prefer to skip meal planning and grocery shopping.

Fully prepared meals

Fully prepared meals are ready to eat with minimal heating required. These are ideal for busy individuals who want to enjoy a home-cooked meal without spending time in the kitchen.

Specialized dietary plans

Many meal services cater for specific nutritional needs, such as keto, vegan, paleo, high-protein, or anti-inflammatory. Most provide detailed ingredient lists and nutritional information online so you can easily check if a meal suits your dietary requirements.

Allergy-friendly meal options

Meal services know how important allergen-free products are to many consumers, such as people with celiac disease or nut allergies. Some companies also specially wrap their products to prevent cross-contamination.

Organic food and sustainable sourcing

Many meal subscription services proudly showcase their certified organic and sustainable options on their websites. These credentials may include USDA Organic certification, MSC-certified sustainable seafood, or B Corp certification.

Weight loss plans

If you’re looking for a strict diet meal plan, many health-focused meal services will send you dietitian-planned meals to enable you to eat healthier and lose weight. Meal kits, in general, help you to control your eating by planning meals ahead of time and learning new cooking techniques you can integrate into your daily life.

Family plans

Many meal delivery services feature family meal plans and “kid-friendly” recipes. Kid-friendly recipes are dishes your kids may recognize and are typically not spicy. These plans typically include meals designed for four people and often cost less per serving.

How Do Meal Delivery Services Work?

Meal delivery services simplify meal planning and preparation by delivering ready-to-cook or pre-prepared meals directly to your door. The process typically starts with signing up on a company’s website or mobile app. During registration, you may be prompted to answer questions about dietary preferences and restrictions, which helps the service personalize meal recommendations.

Once signed up, you can choose their meals from a weekly rotating menu. You can select portion sizes and number of meals per week based on your individual or family needs. Meal delivery services generally emphasize flexibility, allowing you to skip weeks or change meal choices as long as you do so by a specified deadline before the next delivery.

How to Choose the Right Meal Delivery Service for Your Needs?

Dietary preferences and restrictions

Choose a service that aligns with your dietary needs. Whether you need gluten-free, high-protein, or vegan options, the best meal plans will accommodate your requirements.

Variety and flexibility

Look for services that offer a wide range of meal options and the flexibility to change your selections each week. This ensures you won’t get bored and can adjust based on your preferences.

Cost

Budget is a crucial factor. Consider whether you need the cheapest meal delivery service or if you’re willing to pay more for premium options. Compare the cost per meal to see what options fit your budget.

Customer support

Meal delivery companies offer customer support services like online assistants and agents who can be contacted by phone or email. Their websites often include features like FAQs, blogs, cooking tips, and nutrition advice. Look for a company that provides what you need.

Meal Delivery Glossary:

Pre-portioned ingredients (Meal kits)

Components of a meal that have been measured and cut to the exact amounts required for a recipe.

Fully prepared meals

Complete dishes that are cooked and assembled prior to delivery, requiring minimal to no preparation. They are delivered chilled or frozen to maintain quality and freshness.

Subscription service

A business model where customers pay a recurring fee to receive their meal service according to a pre-agreed schedule.

Dietary preferences

Requirements or choices that influence an individual's eating habits, such as vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, keto, paleo, and other specialized diets.

Freshness guarantee

A commitment by meal delivery services to deliver ingredients at their peak freshness to maximize their flavor and nutritional value.

FAQs

Should I use a meal delivery service or order takeout food?

Opting for a meal delivery service gives you healthier, customizable options and can be more cost-effective. It's a convenient choice for those who want meals delivered with ease and variety through meal subscription services.

Are meal delivery services healthy?

Many meal delivery services focus on healthy eating, offering balanced meals with fresh ingredients catering to various dietary needs.

Can I customize the meals?

Most meal delivery services allow you to customize your meal selections each week, letting you choose meals that fit your tastes and dietary preferences.

Can I pause or cancel my meal delivery subscription?

Yes, most meal delivery services offer flexible subscription plans that allow you to pause or cancel your deliveries as needed.

Are meal delivery services environmentally friendly?

Many meal delivery services are committed to sustainability, using eco-friendly packaging and sourcing ingredients responsibly to reduce their environmental impact.
